title: dendrochilum anfractum var. anfractoides
intro: Dendrochilum anfractum var. anfractoides, commonly known as a species of orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Dendrochilum anfractum var. anfractoides include antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, which may help in reducing oxidative stress, managing blood sugar levels, and preventing cancer cell growth. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
